RS–3

SUPPLEMENTAL RESTRAINT SYSTEM – DESCRIPTION

DESCRIPTION

This vehicle is equipped with an SRS (Supplemental Restraint System) which comprises a driver airbag, and front passenger airbag if fitted. Where fitted, it is designed to be of benefit only in conjunction with the front seat belt(s) being worn. In a collision, if the shock is greater than a specified value, the airbag(s) stored in the steering wheel pad and front passenger airbag assembly are inflated instantaneously.

SRS Warning Light
